notes: Node-geometry transport of raw source attributes: the scene draws examples/assets/regression/node-local-attributes.gltf (nonunit and signed-zero NORMAL lanes, hierarchies with both determinant signs) and a scene-created mesh under a scaled parent with one node material, in a colour task and two geometry tasks. The native nodeGpu receipts of one frame (BBLITE_NODE_GPU_CAPTURE=1) must bind the source attribute bytes and index sequence, one texture and sampler across the views, a distinct mesh UBO per mesh and view on Dawn, and the pin's world matrices exact to the word except signed zeros (the scene-created mesh within 2 ulps); the browser observation (checks/plugins/webgpu-recorder.init.js) must upload the same attribute, index and world bytes.
